title: Wi-Fi keeps disconnecting on one laptop
text: Update the wireless adapter driver, forget the network and rejoin, and disable modern standby so the radio does not sleep. If only one device drops, reset that device's network profile rather than the router.

title: Wireless signal is weak in back rooms
text: Relocate the access point away from metal cabinets, switch the 5GHz band to a lower channel width, and add a mesh extender in the affected room. Verify with a site survey app before and after.

title: VPN client will not establish a tunnel
text: Confirm the pre-shared key and gateway address, check that UDP 500/4500 are not blocked by local security software, and reinstall the VPN adapter driver if the connection attempt times out immediately.

title: VPN connects but internal file shares are unreachable
text: Verify the split-tunnel route includes the internal subnet, flush the DNS resolver cache, and confirm internal DNS servers were pushed by the VPN policy rather than falling back to the public resolver.

title: DNS resolution fails only for internal hostnames
text: Check that the internal DNS suffix is applied, that the resolver order lists the internal server first, and that split-horizon DNS records are published on the internal zone.

title: Public websites load but the intranet portal times out
text: Test whether the intranet hostname resolves at all; if it does not, the client is likely using the public DNS resolver instead of the corporate one supplied over VPN or the office network.

title: Firewall blocks a newly deployed internal application
text: Add an explicit allow rule for the application's destination port, confirm the rule is placed above any default-deny rule, and test with the host firewall temporarily disabled to isolate the layer at fault.

title: Outbound connections silently fail behind the corporate proxy
text: Configure the system proxy settings to match the PAC file, verify proxy authentication credentials have not expired, and check whether the application honors the system proxy or requires its own setting.

title: Ethernet port shows connected but no network access
text: Replace the patch cable, confirm the switch port is assigned to the correct VLAN, and check that the port has not been administratively disabled after a recent office move.

title: Network speed is far below the plan's rated bandwidth
text: Run a wired speed test to rule out Wi-Fi overhead, check for background sync clients consuming bandwidth, and confirm the ISP modem has not fallen back to a lower negotiated link rate.

title: Video calls freeze while file transfers continue fine
text: This usually indicates bufferbloat rather than raw bandwidth; enable Smart Queue Management or QoS prioritization for real-time traffic on the router and retest during a call.

title: Guest Wi-Fi network is visible but never connects
text: Confirm the guest SSID is not isolated onto a VLAN with no DHCP scope configured, and check the captive portal certificate has not expired, which silently blocks the connection.

title: VPN disconnects every time the laptop sleeps
text: Disable the always-on VPN's dependency on the network adapter that gets torn down at sleep, or enable reconnect-on-wake in the client's power settings.

title: Split-tunnel VPN cannot reach the printer on the home network
text: This is expected: split-tunnel routes only corporate subnets through the tunnel, so local-network devices are unreachable while connected unless the printer's subnet is explicitly excluded from the tunnel.

title: Proxy auto-configuration script returns the wrong gateway for remote staff
text: Update the PAC file's location-detection logic to fall back to the VPN gateway when the public IP does not match an office egress range, otherwise remote users are routed through a dead proxy.

title: Forgot the account sign-in password
text: Select Forgot password on the sign-in page, follow the verification link sent to the recovery email, and choose a new unique password. Contact an administrator if the recovery address is no longer accessible.

title: Multi-factor authentication codes are always rejected
text: Synchronize the phone's clock, confirm the correct account is enrolled in the authenticator app, and use a backup code if the time drift cannot be corrected immediately.

title: Account is locked after repeated failed sign-in attempts
text: Wait for the automatic lockout window to expire or have an administrator clear the lockout counter; repeatedly retrying the same wrong password only extends the lockout.

title: Single sign-on redirects to a blank page after login
text: Clear cached SSO session cookies, confirm the identity provider's certificate has not rotated without updating the service provider's trust configuration, and retry in a private browser window.

title: New employee has no access despite an active directory account
text: Check that the account was added to the correct security group; directory replication delay across sites can also cause a newly created account to appear active in one region before another.

title: User profile picture and display name will not update
text: Changes to directory attributes can take up to 24 hours to propagate to dependent applications; force a manual sync in the identity portal to update immediately.

title: Password reset email never arrives
text: Check the spam and quarantine folders first, confirm the recovery address on file is current, and have an administrator resend the reset link from the identity console if the mail simply never left the send queue.

title: Cannot change the password because it says it was used recently
text: The password-history policy blocks reuse of the last several passwords; choose a password that differs from recent ones by more than a trailing digit to satisfy the complexity check.

title: Shared mailbox permission was revoked without explanation
text: Check whether the user was recently removed from the distribution group that grants shared-mailbox access, often as a side effect of an offboarding or reorganization script.

title: Account shows as disabled immediately after a manager change
text: Some HR-integration workflows automatically suspend accounts pending manager re-approval; have the new manager approve the pending access request in the identity workflow tool.

title: Biometric login stopped working after an OS update
text: Re-enroll the fingerprint or face profile, since some OS updates invalidate the secure-enclave binding used for biometric sign-in, requiring a fresh enrollment rather than a repair.

title: Security questions were reset and the user cannot recall the new answers
text: Security-question recovery is deprecated in favor of MFA; have an administrator switch the account to authenticator-based recovery instead of relying on security questions.

title: Session logs out every few minutes on a shared kiosk
text: Kiosk devices are intentionally configured with a short idle timeout for privacy; extend the timeout only for devices explicitly exempted in the kiosk policy, not globally.

title: Federated login works on desktop but fails on mobile
text: Mobile apps sometimes use an embedded webview that blocks third-party cookies required by the identity provider; switch the app's authentication flow to the system browser instead.

title: User was accidentally added to two duplicate directory accounts
text: Merge or deactivate the duplicate account created during a bulk import, and re-point any group memberships and mailbox delegations to the surviving primary account.

title: Laptop battery drains far faster than it used to
text: Check battery health in the diagnostics tool, install pending firmware updates, lower display brightness, and identify high-usage background processes. Replace the battery once full-charge capacity drops below 60 percent.

title: Laptop will not turn on at all
text: Try a different charger and outlet first, hold the power button for 15 seconds to force a hardware reset, and remove any dock or peripheral that could be shorting the power rail before assuming a motherboard fault.

title: Print jobs stay queued and never print
text: Cancel pending jobs, restart the print spooler service, and clear stale spool files. Reinstall the printer driver if jobs continue to sit in the queue.

title: Printer prints faded or streaky pages
text: Run the built-in nozzle or drum cleaning cycle, check toner or ink levels, and align the print head if streaks appear only on one side of the page.

title: External monitor is not detected when the laptop is docked
text: Reseat the dock's display cable, update the dock's firmware, and confirm the monitor input is set to the correct source rather than an idle port.

title: Monitor shows flickering at certain refresh rates
text: Lower the refresh rate to the panel's native rating, replace the display cable with a certified one, and update the graphics driver, since flickering is most often a cable or driver mismatch rather than a dying panel.

title: Keyboard types the wrong characters on some keys
text: Confirm the correct keyboard layout is selected in system settings; a locale mismatch is far more common than physical key failure and produces exactly this symptom.

title: Docking station intermittently drops all connected peripherals
text: Update the dock firmware and the laptop's Thunderbolt or USB controller driver, and test with a shorter or different cable, since intermittent full-dock dropout is usually a cable or firmware issue rather than a failed dock.

title: Webcam image is dark or washed out during calls
text: Disable auto-exposure and set manual brightness in the camera settings, and ensure the light source is in front of the user rather than behind, since backlighting causes exactly this symptom.

title: External hard drive is not recognized by the operating system
text: Try a different cable and port first, check Disk Management or Disk Utility for an unassigned drive letter, and reformat only as a last resort since that erases data.

title: Laptop fan runs at full speed constantly
text: Check for a runaway background process consuming CPU, clean dust from the intake vents, and reapply thermal paste if the fan has been loud since before any software changes.

title: Second monitor works but is limited to a low resolution
text: The current cable or port likely only supports a lower display standard; switch to a DisplayPort or full-bandwidth HDMI cable to unlock the monitor's native resolution.

title: Trackpad clicks register as double clicks
text: Lower the double-click speed sensitivity in the input settings, and update the trackpad driver, since worn mechanical switches under the pad can also cause this over time.

title: Laptop screen has a persistent dim vertical band
text: This is a symptom of a failing backlight strip or a loose display cable rather than a software issue; schedule a hardware repair rather than adjusting brightness settings.

title: USB-C charging works only at a very slow rate
text: Confirm the charger and cable both support the laptop's rated wattage; a cable rated for data-only or a lower-wattage charger will still charge, just far too slowly.

title: Application crashes immediately on startup
text: Install the latest application patch, remove corrupted cache files, verify available disk space, and start with extensions disabled. Collect crash logs before reinstalling.

title: Application update fails partway through installation
text: Check that the installer has write permission to the install directory, temporarily disable endpoint protection that may be quarantining installer files, and retry with an elevated prompt.

title: License key is rejected even though it was purchased recently
text: Confirm the license server's clock is synchronized, since expired-certificate style clock skew causes valid keys to appear invalid, and check that the seat count has not already been consumed by another device.

title: Application will not open a file type it used to open fine
text: Check whether a different application recently claimed the file association, and reset the default app for that file extension in the operating system's settings.

title: Browser extension causes pages to load slowly
text: Disable extensions one at a time to isolate the offender, and check the extension's permissions for background network access that could be throttling page loads.

title: Software installed for one user is missing for another user on the same machine
text: Some installers register per-user rather than machine-wide; reinstall with the machine-wide or all-users option selected so every profile on the device gets the application.

title: Uninstalling an application leaves behind leftover files that block reinstall
text: Run the vendor's dedicated cleanup utility rather than only using the standard uninstaller, since leftover registry keys or config folders commonly block a clean reinstall.

title: Application freezes only when opening large files
text: Increase the application's allocated memory limit in its settings if configurable, and check whether a background auto-save or indexing feature is competing for disk I/O on large files.

title: Two installed applications conflict and one always crashes the other
text: Check for a shared system library version conflict; updating both applications to their latest versions usually resolves a stale shared-dependency conflict.

title: Operating system update removed a previously working printer driver
text: Reinstall the manufacturer's driver package after the update, since OS updates sometimes replace vendor drivers with a generic in-box driver that lacks full functionality.

title: Application shows a corrupted or unreadable settings profile
text: Rename or delete the local settings/profile folder to force the application to regenerate defaults, after first backing up the folder in case custom settings need to be restored manually.

title: Software licensing dashboard shows fewer seats than were purchased
text: Check for seats consumed by decommissioned devices that were never explicitly deactivated in the license console; deactivate stale device entries to free the seats.

title: Browser repeatedly asks to save the same password
text: Clear the saved-password prompt cache for that site and confirm the site's login form has not changed its field names, which can cause the browser to fail to recognize a saved match.

title: Application performance degrades the longer it stays open
text: This points to a memory leak; check memory usage over time in a system monitor and restart the application periodically until a patched version is available.

title: Newly installed application is blocked by endpoint security policy
text: Request an allow-list exception through the security team for the application's publisher certificate, since unsigned or newly-published software is blocked by policy until reviewed.

title: Need to undo unwanted edits to a shared cloud document
text: Open the document details, choose Version history, select a timestamp before the unwanted edit, and restore or download that version. Deleted files remain in trash for 30 days.

title: Cloud storage quota is full and new files will not upload
text: Empty the trash folder first, since deleted files still count against quota for 30 days, then archive or offload large infrequently-used files to free additional space.

title: Shared folder permissions do not match what was configured
text: Inherited permissions from a parent folder can override explicit settings on a subfolder; break inheritance on the subfolder if it needs permissions different from its parent.

title: Automatic backup job silently stopped running weeks ago
text: Check the backup agent's log for an authentication token that expired, which is the most common silent-failure cause, and re-authenticate the agent to resume scheduled runs.

title: Restoring from backup only recovers an older version than expected
text: Confirm which backup retention tier was selected; some tiers only keep daily snapshots and roll off intraday versions faster than users expect.

title: Sync client shows files as syncing indefinitely without finishing
text: Look for one specific file with an illegal character or path length exceeding the platform limit; a single stuck file can block the entire sync queue behind it.

title: Colleague cannot open a file shared with them
text: Confirm the share link's permission level was not set to view-only when edit access was intended, and check that the recipient's account domain is on the sharing allow-list.

title: Deleted file is missing from the trash folder
text: Files deleted more than the retention window ago are purged permanently; check with an administrator whether an organization-level backup snapshot from before the deletion still exists.

title: File shows as corrupted after a sync conflict
text: Look in the sync client's conflict folder for a duplicate copy created during the conflict, since the client usually preserves both versions rather than silently discarding one.

title: Large video file fails to upload to cloud storage every time
text: Check the platform's per-file size limit and try uploading over a wired connection, since an unstable connection causes large uploads to restart from zero rather than resuming.

title: Storage usage report does not match the size shown in the file browser
text: Usage reports typically include prior file versions and trashed items that the file browser hides by default; check the version-history and trash sizes separately.

title: Team members lost access to a shared drive after an owner left the company
text: Ownership must be explicitly transferred before an account is deactivated; have an administrator reassign ownership of the orphaned drive to restore team access.

title: Offline files edited on a laptop did not sync after reconnecting
text: Check that the sync client was actually running (not just installed) during the offline period, since offline edits only queue for upload if the client was active when changes were made.

title: Cannot permanently delete a file due to a legal hold
text: Files under an active legal hold or retention policy cannot be purged regardless of trash settings; the hold must be released by compliance before deletion is possible.

title: Shared link to a document expired unexpectedly
text: Organization policy may enforce a maximum link lifetime regardless of the expiration chosen when sharing; generate a new link or request a policy exception for longer-lived links.

title: Other participants hear an echo during video calls
text: Use headphones, mute duplicate audio devices, reduce speaker volume, and ensure only one meeting client is active in the room. Run the audio device test before rejoining.

title: Screen sharing shows a black or frozen window to other participants
text: Some applications block capture by default for content-protection reasons; disable hardware-accelerated capture or share the entire screen instead of a single protected window.

title: Calendar meeting invite never arrives for external attendees
text: Check that external calendar federation is enabled for the domain, since internal invites can succeed while external delivery silently fails without federation configured.

title: Meeting recording is missing from the expected library
text: Cloud recordings can take up to several hours to process before appearing; if still missing after that window, check whether the host's account has recording storage enabled.

title: Chat notifications stopped appearing on desktop
text: Check operating-system notification permissions for the app first, since OS-level updates sometimes reset per-app notification permissions without any in-app setting changing.

title: Whiteboard content disappears after the meeting ends
text: Whiteboards must be explicitly saved to a persistent workspace before the meeting closes; an unsaved in-meeting whiteboard is discarded when the session terminates.

title: Breakout rooms fail to reassign participants automatically
text: Automatic assignment requires attendees to have joined with an authenticated account rather than as a guest; guests must be assigned manually.

title: Background blur or virtual background is unavailable on a work laptop
text: This feature requires a minimum graphics capability; on machines below the threshold it is disabled automatically rather than shown as an error.

title: Meeting audio works for some participants but not others on the same call
text: This pattern usually points to one participant's browser missing microphone permission rather than a platform-wide outage; check that individual's site permissions first.

title: Calendar shows a meeting at the wrong time for one attendee
text: Confirm that attendee's device time zone setting matches their actual location; a stale or manually-overridden time zone is the most common cause of a single-attendee time mismatch.

title: Cannot join a meeting from a mobile device even though the link works on desktop
text: Confirm the mobile app is updated to the minimum supported version, since older app builds are sometimes blocked from joining meetings that use a newer protocol.

title: Shared chat channel history is missing after switching devices
text: History sync depends on the retention policy configured for that channel; a shorter organizational retention window will show less history on any newly-signed-in device, not just the new one.

title: Presenter's screen share lags noticeably behind their actions
text: Lower the share resolution or frame rate setting, and close other bandwidth-heavy applications on the presenter's machine, since screen-share lag is almost always local upload bandwidth.

title: Meeting poll results are visible to attendees when they should be host-only
text: Check the poll's visibility setting at creation time; results default to shared unless the host explicitly restricts visibility before launching the poll.

title: Recurring meeting series lost one occurrence after a calendar migration
text: Migrations sometimes fail to carry over exceptions to a recurring series; manually recreate the missing single occurrence rather than editing the whole series.

title: Outgoing email is taking hours to be delivered
text: Check service status, mailbox quota, inbox rules, and outbound attachment size. Inspect message trace and spam quarantine when delivery remains delayed.

title: Legitimate email is repeatedly marked as spam
text: Add the sender to the safe-senders list and check the message's authentication headers, since a failed SPF or DKIM check on the sender's side is the most common root cause.

title: Distribution list email is not reaching all members
text: Check for members whose individual mailbox rejected the message due to quota or moderation settings; distribution-list delivery reports each recipient's status separately.

title: Email attachment is stripped before it reaches the recipient
text: Check the outbound attachment-size and file-type policy, since executable or oversized attachments are silently removed by the mail gateway rather than bounced.

title: Out-of-office autoresponder is not triggering for internal senders
text: Autoresponder rules can be scoped to external senders only by default; update the rule scope if internal colleagues also need to receive the automatic reply.

title: Emails sent to a specific domain always bounce
text: Check the non-delivery report's exact error code, since a bounce to one domain specifically often indicates that domain's mail server has blocklisted the sending organization's IP range.

title: Mailbox migration left some folders empty
text: Check the migration job's per-folder status report for a skipped folder due to an item exceeding the size limit, since migrations typically skip rather than fail on oversized items.

title: Calendar invites sent by email show the wrong organizer
text: This occurs when a delegate sends on behalf of another mailbox without the send-on-behalf permission properly configured, causing the invite to misattribute the organizer.

title: Email search only returns results from the current folder
text: Expand the search scope to all folders explicitly; the default search scope in most mail clients is the currently open folder, not the entire mailbox.

title: Read receipts are not being sent even though the setting is enabled
text: Read-receipt requests can be silently declined by the recipient's client settings; the sender's setting only controls the request, not whether a receipt is actually returned.

title: Shared mailbox sent items appear in the individual's mailbox instead
text: Enable the setting that saves sent items in the shared mailbox rather than the sender's personal mailbox, which is off by default in most configurations.

title: Inbox rules stopped running after a password change
text: Server-side rules can be disabled if the mailbox required re-authentication; re-enable the affected rules manually after confirming the account is fully re-authenticated.

title: New employee's email signature does not match the company template
text: Centrally managed signatures are applied by a transport rule rather than a client-side setting; confirm the new mailbox has been included in the signature transport rule's scope.

title: Email delivery is delayed only for messages with large attachments
text: Large attachments queue behind a separate throughput limit on the outbound connector; consider a file-sharing link instead of a direct attachment for files over a few megabytes.

title: Vacation responder sends duplicate replies to the same sender
text: Most autoresponders should suppress repeat replies to the same sender within a rolling window; confirm that setting is enabled rather than assuming a client bug.

title: Suspicious phishing email needs to be reported
text: Use the built-in report-phishing button rather than forwarding the message, since forwarding can strip the headers the security team needs to trace the sender.

title: Endpoint protection flags a legitimate internal tool as malware
text: Submit the file hash to the security team for an allow-list exception rather than disabling protection, since disabling endpoint protection organization-wide is never the correct fix for one false positive.

title: Security certificate for an internal site expired and blocks access
text: Internal certificate renewal must be requested from the PKI team before expiry; browsers correctly refuse to bypass an expired certificate warning for internal HTTPS sites.

title: Device fails a compliance check and loses access to corporate resources
text: Check which specific policy failed in the compliance report, most commonly a missed disk-encryption or OS-patch-level requirement, and remediate that one item rather than reinstalling the device.

title: Unrecognized sign-in alert was received for an account
text: Change the password immediately and review the account's active sessions list, revoking any session from an unrecognized device or location before investigating further.

title: USB drive is blocked from being used on a work laptop
text: Removable-storage restriction is enforced by device policy; request a scoped exception through the security team rather than attempting to bypass the block locally.

title: VPN client reports a certificate trust error after a recent update
text: The VPN provider likely rotated its signing certificate; update the client to the version that ships with the new trusted root rather than manually trusting the certificate.

title: Encrypted file cannot be opened after switching to a new laptop
text: Confirm the encryption key or certificate was exported and imported to the new device before the old device was retired; a key left only on the old device cannot decrypt the file elsewhere.

title: Multi-factor prompt is received for a login the user did not initiate
text: Deny the prompt immediately and change the password, since an unexpected MFA prompt typically means the password alone has already been compromised.

title: Security awareness training module will not mark as complete
text: Confirm the browser allowed the training platform's tracking script to run; ad-blocking or strict tracking-prevention settings can prevent completion from registering even though the video finished.

title: Firewall on a personal device blocks the corporate VPN client
text: Add an explicit application exception for the VPN client in the personal firewall rather than disabling the firewall entirely.

title: Data loss prevention policy blocks sending a file that should be allowed
text: Check which specific DLP rule matched in the policy tip shown to the sender, since most policies allow a documented business-justification override rather than a hard block.

title: Password manager will not autofill on a specific website
text: The site's login form likely uses non-standard field names; add a manual site match rule in the password manager rather than assuming the credentials are wrong.

title: Security patch installation causes a reboot loop
text: Boot into safe mode and uninstall the specific patch identified in the update history, then report the failure so the patch can be re-tested before wider rollout.

title: Account recovery process requests information the user no longer has
text: Escalate to an administrator for identity verification through an alternate method (manager attestation, ID check) rather than repeatedly retrying an automated flow that cannot succeed.

title: Mobile app crashes every time it is opened after an update
text: Clear the app's cache and data first; if the crash persists, uninstall and reinstall, since a corrupted local cache surviving an update is the most common post-update crash cause.

title: Push notifications for a work app stopped arriving on a phone
text: Check that battery-optimization settings are not restricting the app's background activity, since aggressive power management on many phones silently disables background notification delivery.

title: Corporate device enrollment gets stuck at the same step every time
text: Confirm the device's OS version meets the minimum supported by the mobile device management profile, since an unsupported OS version causes enrollment to stall silently at the same step.

title: Mobile app shows old data and never refreshes
text: Pull-to-refresh only updates the visible list in some apps; fully close and reopen the app to force a complete data resync if pull-to-refresh does not clear stale content.

title: Work profile on a personal phone cannot access the camera
text: Camera access inside a managed work profile is restricted by policy for data-loss-prevention reasons; this is intentional and not a bug to be fixed on the device.

title: Biometric unlock for the work app suddenly requires a PIN every time
text: Re-registering fingerprints or face data on the phone invalidates the app's stored biometric binding; re-enable biometric login inside the app after any OS-level biometric change.

title: App from the internal store fails to install with a signature error
text: The device's trust profile for internal app signing may be outdated; reinstall the internal root certificate profile before retrying the app install.

title: Mobile app logs the user out every time the phone restarts
text: Check whether the app was denied background-refresh permission, since some apps rely on a background token refresh that cannot run if the OS blocks background activity entirely.

title: Company phone battery drains overnight even when idle
text: Check for an app stuck in a wake-lock loop in the battery usage breakdown; a single misbehaving app is far more common than a hardware battery fault at this stage.

title: Managed device wipe was triggered unexpectedly
text: This is typically triggered automatically after a compliance policy violation persists past its grace period; check the MDM console's compliance history for the specific triggering event.

title: App Store or Play Store shows a payment error for a free internal app
text: Internal apps distributed outside the public store should never route through the consumer store's payment flow; confirm the correct internal distribution link is being used.

title: Two-factor push approval notification never arrives on the registered phone
text: Check that notification permissions for the authenticator app were not revoked by a recent OS update, and fall back to a manually-entered code in the meantime.

title: Mobile app calendar shows meetings in the wrong time zone
text: Confirm the phone's automatic time zone setting is enabled rather than a manually-set zone left over from recent travel.

title: Corporate email app will not sync attachments over 25 MB on cellular
text: This is an intentional cellular-data policy limit; attachments over the threshold sync automatically once the device connects to Wi-Fi.

title: Mobile device shows as non-compliant despite meeting all listed requirements
text: Compliance status can lag the device's actual state by one policy-refresh cycle; force a manual policy sync from the device's management app rather than waiting.

title: Wireless mouse cursor is jumpy or unresponsive
text: Replace the batteries first, move the USB receiver away from other wireless devices, and try a different USB port, since RF interference is the most common cause of intermittent jumping.

title: Network printer shows offline even though it is powered on
text: Confirm the printer's IP address has not changed after a router restart; most spoolers cache the old address and need the printer re-added if the IP shifted.

title: Scanner produces blank pages when scanning double-sided documents
text: Check that duplex scanning is explicitly enabled in the scan settings, since single-sided is the default on most drivers even when the feeder supports duplex.

title: Bluetooth headset connects but no audio plays through it
text: Manually select the headset as the active output device, since some operating systems keep the previous output selected even after a new Bluetooth device connects successfully.

title: USB-C dock only charges the laptop when a specific cable is used
text: Confirm the alternate cable is rated for the dock's required power delivery wattage; thinner or shorter USB-C cables are commonly rated for data only, not full charging power.

title: Wireless keyboard and mouse both disconnect at the same time repeatedly
text: Since both devices drop together, check the shared USB receiver or the port's power-saving setting, which can suspend the entire USB hub rather than one specific device.

title: Label printer prints at the wrong scale for the label size
text: Confirm the driver's label stock size matches the physical labels loaded, since a mismatched stock profile is the most common cause of scale or offset errors.

title: Headset microphone works in one app but not another
text: Check that app's individual microphone permission and its own audio-input device selection, since per-app input selection can differ from the system default.

title: Printer duplex (double-sided) printing jams every time
text: Confirm the paper weight is within the duplexer's rated range, since heavier stock frequently jams specifically in the duplex path while feeding single-sided fine.

title: External drive connected to a dock is much slower than connected directly
text: Confirm the dock's port for that drive matches the drive's required interface speed, since docks often downgrade some ports to a slower shared bus under load.

title: Multiple monitors connected through a dock flicker only when both are active
text: This usually indicates the dock's total video bandwidth is exceeded by both displays at their current resolution; lower one display's refresh rate or resolution to fit within the dock's limit.

title: New printer added to the network cannot be found by any computer
text: Confirm the printer and computers are on the same network segment or VLAN, since printer discovery protocols typically do not cross subnet boundaries without explicit configuration.

title: Scanner software crashes when scanning to a shared network folder directly
text: Scan to a local folder first and copy the result manually as a workaround, then check that the scanner has stored credentials that have not expired for the network destination.

title: Docking station displays work but USB ports on it are dead
text: Confirm the dock is receiving its full-rated power from the charger, since underpowered docks frequently keep video working while disabling USB ports to conserve power.

title: Wireless presenter clicker skips slides erratically
text: Move closer to the receiver and remove other 2.4GHz wireless devices nearby, since erratic skipping under normal use is almost always RF congestion rather than a failing clicker.
